messages:
rachel (People Ops): Starting a quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands about hybrid expectations, travel, and offsite logistics. Drop any unanswered Qs here and we'll annotate answers.

omar (Eng): Thx. Is the 2 days/week guidance aimed at headcount planning or more culture/mentoring? Our team is mostly remote EMEA.

rachel (People Ops): Good q. It's primarily for planning capacity in HQ and keeping some in-person culture. For distributed teams you can set an alternate cadence (e.g., monthly collab weeks) if documented in your team norm.

lei (Design): For the fall offsite, will Redwood reimburse travel to alternative airports if it saves money?

finance-bot: Expense policy excerpt: flights must be booked within the approved travel window. Alternate airports may be reimbursed if pre-approved via travel request.

claire (Office Ops): Adding: if you're changing arrival/departure for personal reasons, tag Finance + People Ops on your request so we can evaluate cheaper itineraries that include personal days.

omar (Eng): Any guidance for visa letters / invitation docs for international staff?

rachel (People Ops): Yes 00+ day advance notice preferred. We provide an official invitation and a travel support contact to coordinate visa letters. If you need help sooner DM me.

lei (Design): Childcare support was mentioned 	6 any timeline for a stipend or on-site caregiving at the offsite?

sophia (CEO): We're piloting a caregiver reimbursement program for the fall offsite (details pending). In the meantime we will reimburse reasonable emergency childcare for required travel. We'll publish the eligibility matrix in the FAQ.

omar (Eng): Will there be a central repo for agendas/materials? Email threads get messy.

rachel (People Ops): Yes 	we'll create an internal repo redwood-offsites/2026-fall and grant access to attendees. We'll link the repo in the official invite.

lei (Design): How do visitors/contractors get badges for HQ days during offsite?

claire (Office Ops): Contractors need a sponsor. Submit badge requests at least 72 hours in advance through the badge portal: https://badges.redwood.company. For group visits use the visitor intake form.

omar (Eng): Quick expense nit: per diem numbers?

finance-bot: Per diem caps: $75/day domestic, $150/day international. Use expense code OFFSITE-2026. Receipts required for items >$25.

lei (Design): If my manager asks me to be on-site for more days than the team's norm, what's the escalation path?

rachel (People Ops): Talk to your manager first. If you can't reach an accommodation, escalate to People Ops and we'll coordinate with the manager and leadership to find a solution.

omar (Eng): Will completing travel training still be required for company-paid bookings?

rachel (People Ops): Yes 	complete the travel module in Workday to be enabled for company card bookings.

claire (Office Ops): Volunteers needed for on-site logistics (setup and A/V contacts). React here with :raised_hands: or DM me if you can help.

sophia (CEO): Appreciate the engagement. Team leads please publish your team's in-office days or agreed alternate cadence by next Friday so we can finalize space and catering.

rachel (People Ops): I'll post a short FAQ and the RSVP link in #people-ops by EOD. Thanks all 	closing thread soon but leave follow-ups and we'll add answers.
